Choice architecture in marketing is one of the most powerful sales psychology strategies used by global brands to increase conversions and revenue.

In this video, we break down how giving customers multiple options instead of a simple yes/no decision can significantly increase sales. Big brands like McDonald's use this strategy by offering Small, Medium, and Large meal options — subtly pushing customers toward higher-value purchases without forcing them.

This technique is called Choice Architecture, where customer decisions are influenced by how options are presented. Instead of asking “Kharidna hai ya nahi?”, smart businesses ask “Kaunsa option aapke liye best hai?”

How choice architecture influences buying behavior
Why customers naturally choose higher-priced options
How McDonald's-style pricing psychology works
